description: This file defines the StateStorageBridge class, which provides functionality for operating on grain state within Orleans, including reading, writing, and clearing state, as well as handling dehydrate and rehydrate processes. It also includes related internal classes for shared storage management.

classes.name: StateStorageBridge`1
classes.description: Implements storage operations for grain state, including loading, saving, and deletion, with support for migration and error handling.

classes.name: StateStorageBridgeSharedMap
classes.description: Provides a thread-safe factory for shared StateStorageBridgeShared instances keyed by storage name, store, and state type.

classes.name: StateStorageBridgeShared`1
classes.description: Holds shared storage details such as name, provider type, store, logger, and activator, with a migration context key.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Reads the state from external storage asynchronously and updates internal state.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Writes the current grain state to external storage asynchronously.

methods.name: ClearStateAsync
methods.description: Clears the grain state in external storage asynchronously.

methods.name: OnDehydrate
methods.description: Handles dehydration by adding current grain state to the dehydration context.

methods.name: OnRehydrate
methods.description: Rehydrates the grain state from the rehydration context.

methods.name: OnError
methods.description: Handles storage errors, wraps non-OrleansExceptions, and logs errors.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a shared instance of StateStorageBridgeShared for a given state type, name, and store.
